about.bounty.cta: Interested in sponsoring a UB for a loved one, employee, member, or constituent? Use the dedicated demand-side page — Sponsor a bounty → — to find people who opted into discovery, draft a simple activity with AI help (default: “take a walk sometime in the next day”), and choose one-time or weekly/monthly. Institutions can also use the API with an X-API-Key; see API Docs.
about.bounty.honor_system: Honor system: GreenDial records the price, the currency, and the user's wallet snapshot, and flags the activity payment_pending — but there is no on-chain escrow and no automatic transfer today. Settling payment to the user is on the sponsor, off-platform. This may evolve; today it's intentionally simple and transparent about that limitation.
about.bounty.intro: Anyone — friends, family, employers, health insurers, or government programs — can sponsor a real, priced health activity for someone they care about or serve. We call these Universal Bounties, or UBs. A UB targets a list of GreenDial users directly and offers to pay for a concrete action: a 10,000-step walk, a preventive screening, a week of home-cooked dinners.
about.bounty.step1: A sponsor creates a UB via POST /bounty: the activity, a health area, a price and currency, an expiration date, and the specific user_ids it's targeting.
about.bounty.step2: Targeted users see the UB surface as one of their daily Suggestions — shown with its price — ahead of GreenDial's regular AI-generated suggestions.
about.bounty.step3: The user accepts the suggestion, which becomes a tracked Activity, and completes it in their own time.
about.bounty.step4: On completion, GreenDial snapshots the user's linked wallet address and marks the activity's payment as pending.
about.bounty.video_caption: Watch a short walkthrough of how Universal Bounties work — from sponsoring a healthy action to the recipient completing it.

about.ethos.heading: Our Ethos
about.ethos.p1: GreenDial is designed to give people access to the benefits of artificial intelligence by providing a simple way to interact with it through a conversational interface — no forms, no appointments, no jargon. You just talk to Doc, and your health profile builds itself.
about.ethos.p2: GreenDial is a free system, created to care about people's well-being and help distribute basic health and life benefits, universally. We believe the advantages of good AI — personalized guidance, patient listening, tireless follow-up — shouldn't be locked behind cost or complexity. Everyone should be able to get that kind of support for sleep, diet, exercise, stress, and the rest of daily life.
about.faq.a1: GreenDial is a free AI health companion. You chat with Doc, a coordinating AI, which routes your questions to specialist agents (diet, exercise, sleep, mental health, relationships, environment, and more) and builds your health profile automatically as you talk.
about.faq.a10: Your profile, conversations, suggestions, and activities are stored as JSON in DigitalOcean Spaces (S3-compatible storage) tied to your account. Email mickey@theservicesexchange.com if you'd like your data exported or deleted.
about.faq.a11: GreenDial is open-source on GitHub. Full endpoint documentation, including the UB API, lives at /docs, and /arazzo walks through ten real usage examples end-to-end.
about.faq.a12: Use the 📣 Feedback tab inside GreenDial to post feedback, bug reports, or suggestions directly. For UB partnerships or anything else, email mickey@theservicesexchange.com.
about.faq.a2: Yes. There's no subscription and no paywalled tier. GreenDial accepts optional donations to help keep the AI running, but using Doc, the specialist agents, Suggestions, and Activities costs nothing.
about.faq.a3: No. GreenDial is a HIPAA-waived personal wellness assistant, not a medical provider. It offers general guidance on sleep, diet, exercise, stress, and everyday well-being — it does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional medical care. If you're experiencing a medical emergency or suicidal ideation, GreenDial's Mind agent will point you to the 988 crisis line, but always seek qualified professional help for medical concerns.
about.faq.a4: As you chat, Doc extracts relevant details — goals, conditions, preferences, context — and saves them to your profile in the background. There are no intake forms to fill out; the more you talk with Doc, the more complete and useful your profile becomes.
about.faq.a5: Beyond Doc, GreenDial has dedicated agents for exercise, diet, sleep, mental health, relationships, environment, and preventive health ("Protect AI"), plus a fully custom agent you can define yourself. When a question touches more than one domain, Cross AI runs the relevant specialists in parallel and synthesizes their perspectives into one answer.
about.faq.a6: Each day, GreenDial generates a small batch of personalized Suggestions — specific, actionable ideas across exercise, diet, and social health. Accept one and it becomes an Activity you can track and mark complete; dismiss it if it's not for you.
about.faq.a7: Anyone can sponsor a priced health activity for a specific GreenDial user — friends and family, employers, health insurers, and government programs all use the same endpoint. See the Universal Bounty section above for the full flow.
about.faq.a8: It's an honor system today: GreenDial records the price, currency, and a snapshot of the user's wallet address when an activity completes, and flags it as payment-pending. There's no on-chain escrow or automatic transfer — the sponsor is responsible for settling payment off-platform.
about.faq.a9: Email mickey@theservicesexchange.com with a bit about who you'd like to sponsor. UB and demand-side preview endpoints require an X-API-Key header — full request/response shapes are documented at /docs.

about.founder.heading: Founder
about.founder.p1: I'm Mickey Shaughnessy, based in Colorado, and I've built things all my life.
about.founder.p2: I built GreenDial because I think the benefits of good AI — patient, personalized, always-available guidance — shouldn't be gated behind cost or complexity. GreenDial is free, and it's built around a simple conversation instead of forms and appointments, because that's the easiest way for anyone to get help with their health and well-being. Universal Bounty extends that same idea outward: it lets anyone — friends, family, employers, insurers, or governments — put real resources directly toward someone's health, through the same simple interface.
about.founder.title: Creator
about.hero.tagline: A free system that puts the benefits of artificial intelligence in everyone's hands, through a simple conversation.
about.how.heading: How It Works
about.how.p1: Doc is your primary AI health coordinator. Talk to Doc about anything — sleep, diet, exercise, stress, relationships — and it routes your question to the right specialist agent behind the scenes (or several at once, synthesized by Cross AI, if your question spans domains). Every conversation quietly builds your health profile, and each day GreenDial generates a small batch of personalized Suggestions you can accept (turning them into trackable Activities) or dismiss.
about.how.p2: Want the mechanics in detail, or ten real conversation walkthroughs? See How It Works and the API Docs.

docs.activate.heading: How agents activate
docs.activate.note: All agents are kind, helpful, and truthful — expert systems backed by scientific and medical LLMs. The Mental Wellness Guide provides the 988 crisis line for users expressing suicidal ideation.
docs.activate.p1: 1. Via Doc (chat-triggered) — Doc checks keyword lists and emits **CALL_AGENT**. Single-domain → specialist. Two or more domains → Cross AI runs matched agents in parallel threads and synthesizes.
docs.activate.p2: 2. Via agent direct chat — Users open an agent's tab; the server routes to POST /chat/agent/{agent_id}. Each agent maintains its own transcript separate from Doc.
docs.activate.p3: 3. Via crontab (scheduled) — agent_runner.py at 08:00 UTC daily. Per-user, per-agent, 20-hour debounce. Results land in the notification bell.
docs.agentchat.desc: Chat directly with a named specialist agent. Each agent maintains its own transcript. Pass "init": true (or empty text) to trigger the agent's welcome message and begin onboarding.
docs.agentchat.f_init: Set true to request welcome message without saving a user turn
docs.agentchat.f_text: User's message. Empty or omitted → triggers intro.
docs.agentprofile.desc: Written by agents during onboarding and chat. Merged into the same profile object.
docs.agentprofile.heading: Agent-specific profile fields
docs.agents.cron_note:
Cron runner: agent_runner.py — 08:00 UTC daily, 20-hour debounce per user per agent (weekly for protect and cross_ai, via each agent's CRON_CADENCE_HOURS). Logs to /var/log/greendial_agents.log. Manual run:
python3 agent_runner.py --agent protect --user user_alice --dry-run
docs.agents.desc: There's no subscription API to manage — every user gets daily check-ins from all specialist agents automatically once notifications are enabled (see notifications_enabled under Settings above). Doc still routes conversations to the right specialist (or several, via Cross AI) behind the scenes; specialists also each have a dedicated chat tab. First activation of a tab triggers a 3-turn onboarding interview that fills domain-specific profile fields.

docs.docpoll.desc: Poll for an unprompted Doc message. The SPA calls this every ~2 minutes while signed in. Rate-limited so Doc stays quiet: max 2 per UTC day, min 6 hours between messages, and a 30-minute quiet window after any Doc chat activity. Requires X-Session-Token. Empty messages means nothing to say (no LLM cost when gated). Delivery is Doc chat only — not the notification bell.

docs.howdoc.heading: How Doc Works
docs.howdoc.markers_note:
Two structured markers are stripped server-side before returning text to the user:
• **PROFILE_UPDATE** {"field": "value"} — persists health data
• **CALL_AGENT** {"agent": "sleep"} — triggers a specialist sub-call
docs.howdoc.mirroring_desc: All agents (Doc and specialists) detect message length and tone from each user turn and inject a style-matching instruction. Very short messages get terse replies; detailed messages get thorough ones. Casual phrasing gets casual responses.

docs.overview.heading: Overview
docs.overview.p1: GreenDial is a personal health platform powered by Doc, a primary AI coordinator, and a team of specialist health agents. Doc guides conversations, builds the user's health profile, and routes domain-specific questions to the right agent. When a message matches two or more agent domains, Cross AI synthesizes perspectives from multiple specialists in parallel.
docs.overview.p2: Agents also run on a server-side cron schedule (08:00 UTC daily), generating personalized check-in notifications for subscribed users. Each agent has its own dedicated chat tab in the UI, with a profile-building onboarding interview on first activation.
docs.overview.p3: Authentication is username + passphrase for the app; HTTP Basic Auth for third-party integrations.
